_comment: Main site settings. baseUrl is the one place the live address is set. tenantMode stays false until a real workshop has signed; then fill in tenant and flip it to true.
_brandTodo: TODO: confirm the brand name. Text anywhere in the data files can use {{ brand }} and it is filled in at build time.
_indexHold: Pages kept out of Google (noindex, no sitemap, no hreflang) even once their copy is real. Last part of the URL, both languages, e.g. "cat-kereta". Empty for now; placeholder copy is already kept out by the placeholder rule.

tenant._comment: Used ONLY when tenantMode is true. Real details of the signed workshop. Leave null until then; never invent an address, map pin, rating or review.

_ga4Comment: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (looks like G-XXXXXXX). Leave empty for no analytics script at all. When set, gtag.js loads on every page and the contact events go to GA4.
